source.title: The Only Weeknight Dal You Need | 20 Minutes, One Pot
source.text:
Weeknight dal that comes together in twenty minutes in one pot. Full ingredient list below.

INGREDIENTS
1 cup red split lentils
1 tablespoon coconut oil
1 medium onion, diced
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 tablespoon fresh ginger, grated
2 teaspoons ground cumin
1 teaspoon ground turmeric
400 ml full-fat coconut milk
2 cups water
salt to taste
fresh coriander to serve

[captions] okay so the first thing you want to do is rinse those lentils really well until the
water runs clear, that takes about a minute. get your pot on medium heat with the coconut oil,
in goes the onion, we're cooking that down for about five minutes until it's soft and just
starting to colour. garlic and ginger next, thirty seconds, you'll smell it. now the spices,
cumin and turmeric, stir those around for maybe twenty seconds so they wake up. lentils in,
coconut milk in, water in, big stir. bring that up to a simmer and then turn it right down.
fifteen minutes, lid on, stirring now and then so nothing catches on the bottom. salt at the
end, not before, and a big handful of coriander over the top. that's it. that's the whole thing.
